paths.name: General interview prep
paths.description: An engine sample with three steps, to test the Prepare for page. A content pass replaces it with the full mapping.

steps.why: Quick mental arithmetic opens almost every trading assessment.
Expected value puzzles are the most common interview question.
Conditioning is how most probability questions are solved.

paths.name: Optiver
paths.description: An engine sample with two steps, to test a firm path. It is not a real mapping.

steps.why: Reported tests are timed arithmetic with negative marking.
